# Airbnb

> Airbnb is a global marketplace for vacation rentals, unique accommodations, and travel experiences with comprehensive support and gifting options.

Airbnb provides travelers with access to diverse lodging options including cabins, beach houses, and unique homes worldwide. The platform offers guest support through its help center, AirCover protection, and flexible reservation management tools, along with gift card options for travel gifting.

## Key Topics

- AirCover
- Guest Support
- Reservations
- Cancellation Policy
- Payment Methods
- Account Management
- Gift Cards
- Travel Gifting
- eGift Cards
- Physical Gift Cards
- Bulk Orders
- Business Gifting
- How to Buy
- FAQ

## Help & Support

- [Airbnb Help Center](https://www.airbnb.com/help): Comprehensive help center with FAQs, guest support resources, reservation management, and AirCover protection information

## Gift Cards & Gifting

- [Airbnb Travel Gift Card](https://www.airbnb.com/giftcards): Purchase and send Airbnb gift cards for travel experiences and accommodations, available as eGift cards and physical cards
